Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. We're ready to move forward with the annual prepay commitment but need to lock the invoice windows and confirm VAT handling across our EU entity. Two quick asks from finance:

1) Can you propose specific invoice dates for the annual upfront charge and the staged drawdown invoices (we prefer YYYY-MM-DD dates to align with our ERP)?
2) We will be paying from our UK entity for the majority of the contract. Will Redwood issue a UK VAT invoice or a US invoice with reverse-charge notes? If you need our VAT registration, I attached the PO and registration.

We need the invoice schedule no later than EOD Jul 30 so our AP team can process the PO and payment.

Appreciate it —

Subject: Re: Annual prepay — invoice cadence + VAT handling

Hi Maya — thanks for the PO and the clear ask. Proposed plan below (we can adjust to match your ERP cutoffs):

- Upfront annual invoice: 2025-08-05 (full committed amount) — invoice will reference PO GF-2025-001 and include payment instructions for wire and ACH.
- Monthly drawdown invoices: 2025-09-01, 2025-10-01, 2025-11-01, 2025-12-01 (these are lightweight settlement invoices reflecting usage drawdowns against the committed credit).
- Final reconciliation invoice: 2026-01-05 (to true-up any over/under usage against the prepay).

VAT / entity notes: Jonas — tagging you here to confirm the invoice entity and VAT text. For UK payor we can either: a) issue a Redwood UK VAT invoice (if you provide the UK billing entity details and VAT ID) or b) issue a Redwood US invoice with reverse-charge wording. Maya — if you want option (a), please confirm UK billing entity name and VAT ID; if option (b) we will include the required reverse-charge note and your VAT ID on the invoice for your AP.

Also: attaching an invoice schedule matrix (Excel) to show the dates, line items, and when drawdown credits will post. Marissa will own the drawdown monitoring and weekly burn report we agreed to.

Next steps:
- Maya: confirm which VAT option and confirm the UK entity name (if option a) — by EOD 7/30.
- Jonas & Priyom: confirm VAT language & remittance routing by EOD 7/30 so we can generate the DocuSign invoice/contract.

Thanks —
Kimberly Park
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference

Kim / Priyom — quick notes on VAT:

- If Greenfield pays from their UK entity and provides a UK VAT ID, we should issue an invoice from Redwood UK Ltd. That avoids reverse-charge admin on their side.
- If they prefer our US invoice, include this line: "Reverse charge applies under Article 194 — customer to self-account for VAT; supplier not charging VAT. VAT ID: [customer VAT ID]."
- For DocuSign flow: we need the UK entity address, VAT ID, and preferred remit bank (we have different wire beneficiaries for UK vs US invoices).

I'll prepare two small template snippets (UK invoice header vs reverse-charge header) and drop them into the DocuSign draft.

Jonas
